evaluation: repeated simulation-augmentation comparison with grouped calibration and held-out real benign samples
malware_split_rule: Per family, train max(1, floor(fraction*n)) while retaining a test sample; singleton families remain test-only.
benign_split_rule: GroupShuffleSplit by package_group, independently repeated for each seed.
threshold_rule: Select threshold maximizing balanced accuracy on grouped OOF predictions for real training malware and real training benign samples only; ties prefer closest to 0.5.

training_comparison.without_simulations: 10%-per-family real malware training subset plus real benign training groups
training_comparison.with_simulations: same real training split plus all 84 self-generated scenario rows

hybrid_balanced_50_50.host_selection: training-only mean mutual information across each signal's five summaries

source_separability_audit.purpose: Grouped OOF check whether the same numeric features distinguish real malware training samples from simulated attacks.

calibration.method: 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold OOF on real training samples only; optimize balanced accuracy
